use_connection_wrapper_send: use ConnectionWrapper to send a serialized object over a multiprocessing connection with pickle5
use_connection_wrapper_recv: use ConnectionWrapper to receive and deserialize an object from a multiprocessing connection
wrap_connection_with_pickle5: wrap a multiprocessing Connection with ConnectionWrapper to enable faster pickle5 serialization
use_cloudpickle_wrapper: use CloudpickleWrapper to serialize a callable function with cloudpickle for multiprocessing
call_cloudpickle_wrapped_fn: call a CloudpickleWrapper instance to invoke the wrapped function with arguments
